A particular focus is dedicated to comprehensively analysing these CSR endeavours' profound impact on the well-being and development of the local communities within this geographically expansive and culturally rich area. Due to the inherent potential negative ramifications associated with the socio -economic activities and environmental degradation often intertwined with the oil and gas industry, it becomes imperative to delve into the myriad of CSR initiatives these companies undertake.
